ayahs.2: Yeh kitaab Allah ghalib hikmat wale ki taraf se naazil ki hui hai.
ayahs.3: Aasmanon aur zameen mein imaan-daaron ke liye yaqeenan bahut si nishaniyan hain.
ayahs.4: Aur khud tumhari paidaaish mein aur un jaanwaron ki paidaaish mein jinhein woh phailaata hai yaqeen rakhne wali qaum ke liye bahut si nishaniyan hain.
ayahs.5: Aur raat din ke badalne mein aur jo kuchh rozi Allah Taala aasman se naazil farma kar zameen ko us ki maut ke baad zinda kar deta hai, (us mein) aur hawaon ke badalne mein bhi un logon ke liye jo aqal rakhte hain nishaniyan hain.
ayahs.6: Yeh hain Allah ki aayatein jinhein hum aap ko raasti se suna rahe hain, pas Allah Taala aur us ki aayaton ke baad yeh kis baat par imaan laayenge.
ayahs.7: Wail aur afsos hai har ek jhoote gunehgaar par.
ayahs.8: Jo aayatein Allah ki apne saamne padhi jaati hui sune phir bhi ghuroor karta hua is tarah uda rahe ke goya suni hi nahin, to aise logon ko dardnaak azaab ki khabar (pahuncha) dijiye.
ayahs.9: Woh jab hamari aayaton mein se kisi aayat ki khabar paa leta hai to us ki hansi udaata hai, yehi log hain jin ke liye ruswaai ki maar hai.
ayahs.10: Un ke peechhe dozakh hai, jo kuchh unhon ne haasil kiya tha woh unhein kuchh bhi nafa na dega aur na woh (kuchh kaam aayenge) jin ko unhon ne Allah ke siwa karsaz bana rakha tha, un ke liye to bahut bada azaab hai.
ayahs.11: Yeh (sar-taa-paa) hidayat hai aur jin logon ne apne Rabb ki aayaton ko na maana un ke liye bahut sakht dardnaak azaab hai.
ayahs.12: Allah hi hai jis ne tumhare liye darya ko taabe bana diya taake us ke hukm se us mein kashtiyan chalen aur tum us ka fazl talaash karo aur taake tum shukr baja laao.
ayahs.13: Aur aasman-o-zameen ki har har cheez ko bhi us ne apni taraf se tumhare liye taabe kar diya hai. Jo ghaur karen yaqeenan woh us mein bahut si nishaniyan paa lenge.
ayahs.14: Aap imaan walon se keh den ke woh un logon se darguzar karen jo Allah ke dinon ki tawaqqo nahin rakhte, taake Allah Taala ek qaum ko un ke kartooton ka badla de.
ayahs.15: Jo neki karega woh apne zaati bhale ke liye aur jo buraai karega us ka wabaal isi par hai, phir tum sab apne Parwardigaar ki taraf lautaaye jaaoge.
ayahs.16: Yaqeenan hum ne Bani Israeel ko kitaab, hukoomat aur nabuwat di thi, aur hum ne unhein pakeeza (aur nafees) roziyan di thin aur unhein dunya walon par fazeelat di thi.
ayahs.17: Aur hum ne unhein deen ki saaf saaf daleelein din, phir unhon ne apne paas ilm ke pahunch jaane ke baad aapas ki zidd-bahas se hi ikhtilaaf barpa kar daala, yeh jin jin cheezon mein ikhtilaaf kar rahe hain un ka faisla qayamat wale din un ke darmiyan (khud) tera Rabb karega.
ayahs.18: Phir hum ne aap ko deen ki (zaahir) raah par qaim kar diya, so aap isi par lage rahen aur naadanon ki khwahishon ki pairawi mein na paden.
ayahs.19: (Yaad rakhen) ke yeh log hargiz Allah ke saamne aap ke kuchh kaam nahin aa sakte. (Samajh len ke) zaalim log aapas mein ek doosre ke rafeeq hote hain aur parhezgaron ka karsaz Allah Taala hai.
ayahs.20: Yeh (Quran) logon ke liye baseerat ki baatein aur hidayat-o-rehmat hai us qaum ke liye jo yaqeen rakhti hai.
ayahs.21: Kya un logon ka jo bure kaam karte hain yeh gumaan hai ke hum unhein un logon jaisa kar denge jo imaan laaye aur nek kaam kiye ke un ka marna jeena yaksaan ho jaaye, bura hai woh faisla jo woh kar rahe hain.
ayahs.22: Aur aasmanon aur zameen ko Allah ne bahut hi adl ke saath paida kiya hai aur taake har shakhs ko us ke kiye hue kaam ka poora badla diya jaaye aur un par zulm na kiya jaayega.
ayahs.23: Kya aap ne ise bhi dekha? Jis ne apni khwaahish-e-nafs ko apna mabood bana rakha hai aur bawajood samajh-boojh ke Allah ne ise gumraah kar diya hai aur us ke kaan aur dil par mohar laga di hai aur us ki aankh par bhi parda daal diya hai, ab aise shakhs ko Allah ke baad kaun hidayat de sakta hai.
ayahs.24: Kya ab bhi tum naseehat nahin pakadte. Unhon ne kaha ke hamari zindagi to sirf dunya ki zindagi hi hai. Hum marte hain aur jeete hain aur hamein sirf zamana hi maar daalta hai, (dar-asal) unhein us ka kuchh ilm hi nahin. Yeh to sirf (qiyaas aur) atkal se hi kaam le rahe hain.
ayahs.25: Aur jab un ke saamne hamari waazeh aur roshan aayaton ki tilawat ki jaati hai, to un ke paas is qaul ke siwa koi daleel nahin hoti ke agar tum sachche ho to hamare baap-daadon ko laao.
ayahs.26: Aap keh dijiye! Allah hi tumhein zinda karta hai phir tumhein maar daalta hai phir tumhein qayamat ke din jama karega jis mein koi shak nahin lekin aksar log nahin samajhte.
ayahs.27: Aur aasmanon aur zameen ki baadshahi Allah hi ki hai aur jis din qayamat qaim hogi us din ahl-e-baatil bade nuqsaan mein padenge.
ayahs.28: Aur aap dekhenge ke har ummat ghutnon ke bal giri hui hogi. Har giroh apne naama-e-aamaal ki taraf bulaaya jaayega, aaj tumhein apne kiye ka badla diya jaayega.
ayahs.29: Yeh hai hamari kitaab jo tumhare baare mein sach sach bol rahi hai, hum tumhare aamaal likhwaate jaate the.
ayahs.30: Pas lekin jo log imaan laaye aur unhon ne nek kaam kiye to un ko un ka Rabb apni rehmat tale le lega, yehi sareeh kaamyabi hai.
ayahs.31: Lekin jin logon ne kufr kiya to (main un se kahoonga) kya meri aayatein tumhein sunaai nahin jaati thin? Phir bhi tum takabbur karte rahe aur tum the hi gunehgaar log.
ayahs.32: Aur jab kabhi kaha jaata ke Allah ka waada yaqeenan sachcha hai aur qayamat ke aane mein koi shak nahin to tum jawaab dete the ke hum nahin jaante qayamat kya cheez hai? Hamein kuchh yunhi sa khayaal ho jaata hai lekin hamein yaqeen nahin.
ayahs.33: Aur un par apne aamaal ki buraaiyan khul gayin aur jis ka woh mazaaq uda rahe the us ne unhein gher liya.
ayahs.34: Aur keh diya gaya ke aaj hum tumhein bhula denge jaise ke tum ne apne is din se milne ko bhula diya tha tumhara thikana jahannam hai aur tumhara madadgaar koi nahin.
ayahs.35: Yeh is liye hai ke tum ne Allah Taala ki aayaton ki hansi udaai thi aur dunya ki zindagi ne tumhein dhoke mein daal rakha tha, pas aaj ke din na to yeh (dozakh) se nikaale jaayenge aur na un se uzr-o-maazrat qabool kiya jaayega.
ayahs.36: Pas Allah ki tareef hai jo aasmanon aur zameen aur tamaam jahaan ka paalne wala hai.
ayahs.37: Tamaam (buzurgi aur) badaai aasmanon aur zameen mein isi ki hai aur wohi ghalib aur hikmat wala hai.
